*** ROQUE LUIS ARMANDO LERENA ON A VOTERS' ROLL ***
column2: *** Voter Records: South Africa, Voting Records 1925-1931 *** - image ark 3:1:3QHV-GQVF-S7YT-8, full-text transcript read 9 October 2026. "STEMDISTRIK POLLING DISTRICT NO. 770 ... 1491 *** Lerena, Roque Luis Armando ***"
column3: *** A RECORD CLASS THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER TOUCHED. *** He is voter *** 1491 in polling district 770 ***, between Leibbrandt and Le Riche in a strictly alphabetical roll. *** These rolls carry an ADDRESS and a TENURE *** - the same page's right-hand columns run "Owner", "Sole Tenant", "Joint Tenant", "Medehuurder", and one reads "Botha Hostel, Trill Rd." *** The division name is not on this page and the columns cannot be aligned from the OCR ***, so his address needs the plate read by eye. Born 1905, he was twenty to twenty-six across this roll.
column4: PRIMARY - name confirmed, address not yet read

column1: *** NUNO FERNANDO LERENA IN A LAND RECORD ***
column2: *** Land Records: South Africa, Farm Records 1895-1955 *** - image ark 3:1:3QHK-F7NW-L7PV, full-text transcript read 9 October 2026: "... Cologne Road . Description of Property ... No. 245 ... Sq . Roods 6,600 Sq . Feet . *** Huno Fernando Lerena 6. 10 . 1924 *** . Purchase Amount"
column3: *** HIS EXACT BIRTH DATE, IN A PROPERTY RECORD. *** "Huno" is the transcriber's reading of *** NUNO ***, and *** 6.10.1924 is his birth date to the day *** - which is how this archive knows the entry is his. *** IT IS THE FIRST LAND RECORD THIS ARCHIVE HAS FOUND FOR ANYONE IN THIS FAMILY. *** /south-africa/ says "a search of South African deeds registers returns no land of his at all" - that was said of *** PABLO ARMANDO ***, and remains true of him; it was never tested on his sons. *** WHAT IT DOES NOT YET GIVE: *** the town. "Cologne Road", lot 245, 6,600 square feet, and a transferor read as "Gough Cooper" are all the transcript offers.
column4: PRIMARY - identified by an exact birth date; the property not yet placed

column1: *** AND ONE LERENA WHO IS NOT OURS, excluded rather than ignored ***
column2: *** Pretoria, Transvaal, Religious Membership Records 1939 *** - image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSK5-4D13. A register of the *** Ned. Geref. SENDING GEMEENTE KRANSPOORT *** - a Dutch Reformed MISSION congregation - listing "Seko Lerena" among Adolf Moyapelo, Paulose Marko, Daniel Gama, Tadius Shumba and Samuel Limbankaka.
column3: *** A DIFFERENT POPULATION ENTIRELY, and the surname is a coincidence. *** Recorded because a bare count of "seven South African Lerena hits" would otherwise be read as seven of this family, and because the next person to run this search will meet him too.

column1: *** WHAT THE SOUTH AFRICAN CORPUS ACTUALLY HOLDS for this surname ***
column2: Seven hits in four collections: *** South Africa, Legal, 1559-2017 (2); South Africa, Orange Free State, Legal, 1938-2007 (1); SOUTH AFRICA, PROPERTIES, 1800-1997 (3); South Africa, Transvaal, Religious, 1652-2017 (1). *** Plus a Fauresmith, Orange Free State, Court Case File of 1855-1871 that pre-dates this family's arrival and has not been opened.
column3: *** PROPERTIES IS THE SEAM. *** Three of the seven are property records and one of those is already identified as Nuno. *** AND IT BEARS ON ROW 106 ONLY INDIRECTLY: *** there is no Cape civil registration here, so Careen Maria's parents are still only reachable through Home Affairs or the Western Cape Archives.
column4: ROUTE OPEN - three of seven hits not yet opened

column1: *** THE URUGUAYAN SIDE, STARTED AND NOT FINISHED ***
column2: Montevideo marriage dispensations return Lerena women the indexes have not given this archive: *** "Florinda Juana Lerena, feligresa de ..."; "... con Margarita Lerena"; "a Dona Antonina Lerena, feligresa de ..."; "a Dona Maria Lerena, feligresa de ..." ***
column3: *** FOUR NAMES, NO PARENTS YET - the snippets are the clerk's dispensation formula, and the parentage sits in the body of each expediente. *** Each needs opening. This is the half of row 194 still to do, and it is the half with the parents in it.
